data.why: The repo bundles everything the app reads: 16 real TESS FFI PNG crops + WCS/label JSONs under Data/dataset_tess_test, the Hipparcos catalog under Data/hybrid, the trained U-Net weights under Results/unet_run3, and precomputed per-frame artefacts under Results/star_id_run used by the default Replay mode, so nothing needs to be copied into data/ or seed/.

goals: Pick a bundled TESS frame and run the full pipeline in Replay mode to see detections, the RANSAC-matched triangle, the Wahba/plate-solve refinement, and the final attitude vs. ground truth in seconds
Compare the classical peak-finder centroids against the U-Net centroids by switching to Live mode and reading the per-stage numbers (pairwise angles, residuals) that drive the accuracy difference
Read the refusal-handling code path (Stage 6 quality gate) to understand how the pipeline would decline to publish an attitude rather than return a wrong one, since all 16 bundled demo frames solve
Vary the U-Net detection threshold in Live mode and observe how it changes the number of centroids, the RANSAC iteration count, and the final angular error
Walk through all 16 bundled demo frames to reproduce the published solve rate (16/16, median 6.93″) and check which frames solve at the first RANSAC attempt vs. after a refusal-retry
Read the final pose-comparison table (predicted RA/Dec/roll vs. CRVAL/CD ground truth) and relate the arcsecond error back to the stated TESS pixel scale (20.57″/px)

review.summary: The tree gets the purpose right (recover pointing from one sky image, check each stage, and accept or reject the result against ground truth), and its Replay-mode phases, tasks and cited numbers hold up on the screens. Before filing it needs fixes: a few specific labels overstate what Replay shows (Stage 4 R, plate-solve iterations, 'refuse'), one feature cites the wrong screenshot, two feature steps were never confirmed, and the Live-mode, threshold, upload and FAIL paths are missing or marked not reached.
